summary: Retest of the iteration_10 fixes, run at a 390x844 viewport on the public URL. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed (11 existing TTS tests plus 2 new rate-limit tests). Notes: all fixed. Clearing both fields and pressing back removes the note, and it stays removed after a reload. Autosave of emptied fields deletes the note while the editor is still open (storage becomes [], the delete button hides and the status shows 'Nueva nota'). Typing again re-creates the note. Clearing the fields and using browser back also leaves storage empty. Pressing delete -> confirm right after typing does not re-create the note (also checked after a reload). Cancelling a delete keeps the note. Create, edit and persistence after a reload still work. Practice /practice/bat-mm1b: while speak-affirmative plays, pressing generate-button pauses the HTMLAudioElement (paused=true) and the button goes back to the volume icon (f613). 9s later it still shows idle, so the watchdog raised no false error. The speak buttons have aria-label 'Escuchar frase' when idle and 'Detener audio' while playing. Tapping a playing button again stops it, and the back button stops audio. Every POST /api/tts and mp3 GET returned 200, and no speak-*-error appeared. Cached POSTs are never rate limited (35 rapid requests all returned 200). A unit test confirmed the limiter: 30 calls allowed, the 31st returns 429, and other IPs are unaffected. The live 429 was not tested to avoid 30+ paid generations. Deprecated packages detected: none (expo-audio is used, not expo-av).

minor.issue: The rate limit is keyed on request.client.host, which behind the k8s ingress is the ingress pod IP (backend logs show only 10.219.0.5 and 10.219.0.6). So the 30 new generations/min is effectively shared by ALL users per ingress pod, not per user, and in production one busy class could block everyone. Use the first IP in the X-Forwarded-For header (fall back to client.host). Reference: /app/backend/server.py:108
_tts_hits is never pruned for IPs that stop sending requests, so it grows slowly (minor). It is also per worker process. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:83-93

action_items: Optional: key the TTS rate limit on the first IP in X-Forwarded-For instead of request.client.host (currently the ingress IP, so all users share one bucket) (server.py:108).

Optional: in tts.ts, the 8s watchdog marks an error if playback has not started; on a very slow network, audio that starts after 8s would play while the UI shows an error. Consider clearing the error/setting 'playing' on a later playbackStatusUpdate where playing=true.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:108 rate-limit identity is the ingress IP (see backend minor issue).
tts.ts:79-84 the watchdog has no recovery path if audio starts late (after 8s); low impact.
seed_data_creation: None. Test notes lived only in the per-session browser localStorage (fresh for each run). The TTS cache was hit for existing sentences; no new TEST_ backend records were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notes are stored in localStorage key 'notes.v1' on web, and each browser_automation call starts with fresh storage. Speak state: aria-label 'Escuchar frase' = idle, 'Detener audio' = playing; icon codepoints f613 = idle, f59e = stop. expo-audio on web does not attach <audio> to the DOM, so to check paused/playing, hook HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play via add_init_script and then reload. Run backend tests with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported from frontend/.env (pytest.ini uses xdist).
